title: Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan Rate Schedule: Principal Bands, APR, Terms and Origination Fee
content:
## Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan rate schedule

The Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan is sold in six principal bands, from Paystride Payroll Loan 500 to Paystride Payroll Loan 5000. For each tier this schedule states the smallest and the largest principal in the tier (USD), the fixed annual percentage rate disclosed at origination (percent), the loan terms offered (months), the origination fee deducted from the amount disbursed (USD), and the APR reduction when repaying by payroll deduction (percentage points).

| Tier | Smallest principal | Largest principal | Fixed APR at origination | Terms offered | Origination fee | APR reduction for payroll deduction |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Payroll Loan 500 | $300.00 | $500.00 | 24.99% | 6 months | $20.00 | 0.0 percentage points |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 1000 | $500.01 | $1000.00 | 22.99% | 6 or 9 months | $20.00 | 0.0 percentage points |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 2000 | $1000.01 | $2000.00 | 19.99% | 9 or 12 months | $20.00 | 0.0 percentage points |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 3000 | $2000.01 | $3000.00 | 17.99% | 12 or 18 months | $0.00 | 0.0 percentage points |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 4000 | $3000.01 | $4000.00 | 15.99% | 12, 18 or 24 months | $0.00 | 0.0 percentage points |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 5000 | $4000.01 | $5000.00 | 13.99% | 18 or 24 months | $0.00 | 0.0 percentage points |

## Reading the schedule

- **The bands meet at the cent.** The smallest principal of every tier above Paystride Payroll Loan 500 is one cent more than the largest principal of the tier below it, so every principal from $300.00 to $5000.00 lies in exactly one band.
- **The APR is fixed at origination.** The rate in the table is the annual percentage rate disclosed when the loan is made, and it is the rate of that tier.
- **Terms.** Only the terms listed for a tier are offered in that tier; a 24-month term, for example, appears only in Paystride Payroll Loan 4000 and Paystride Payroll Loan 5000.
- **Origination fee.** The fee is $20.00 in Paystride Payroll Loan 500, 1000 and 2000 and $0.00 in Paystride Payroll Loan 3000, 4000 and 5000. It is deducted from the amount disbursed rather than charged separately.
- **Payroll deduction.** The APR reduction for repaying by payroll deduction is 0.0 percentage points in every tier, so repaying by payroll deduction does not lower the APR shown.

## Hypothetical band placements

The amounts below are illustrative inputs, not offers.

| Hypothetical principal | Band it lies in | Terms offered | Origination fee | Amount disbursed after the fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| $500.00 | Paystride Payroll Loan 500 | 6 months | $20.00 | $480.00 |
| $500.01 | Paystride Payroll Loan 1000 | 6 or 9 months | $20.00 | $480.01 |
| $1500.00 | Paystride Payroll Loan 2000 | 9 or 12 months | $20.00 | $1480.00 |
| $2750.00 | Paystride Payroll Loan 3000 | 12 or 18 months | $0.00 | $2750.00 |
| $250.00 | no band (below the smallest principal of every tier) | none | none | none |
